entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Do you have plans to go to the[n]post-festival party with anyone?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm going with Ryuji,[n]but it'll be kinda weird[n]with just the two of us...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: What was his name? Kitagawa?[n]The guy from the school trip.[n]He's going back...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm counting on you, so come[n]to the gym, OK? Save me!
